The B-5b rejection case only probes the strict 'footprint = gasLimit+1' side, which '>' and '>=' judge identically, so it is the negative control — as is the F-A2 equality-gap case, whose remote (golden Σ − 1 = 593599) sits far below gasLimit and never touches this comparison.
